chunks: Then He said: They will indeed come to know soon.

key_terms.سَيَعْلَمُونَ: They will know (future tense, indicating certainty)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'They will indeed come to know soon' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tadhallul* (humiliation) and the eventual realization of truth by the disbelievers when the signs of God become undeniable. It serves as a warning that their current arrogance will be replaced by regret on the Day of Judgment, a theme frequently echoed in the narratives of previous prophets. The verse underscores the inevitability of divine justice, reinforcing the Shia belief in the ultimate triumph of truth over falsehood.
